name: a1v6-vo-tara-1
text: Apni factory ke liye address chahiye? Toh yeh dekhiye! रोहतक mein, 138 acre ka industrial park. Plots, 400 se 4,000 gaj tak. 24 metre wide roads, trucks ke liye. Apna electrical substation, STP, CCTV aur fire safety. NH-152D se sirf 10 minute दूर. Aur Haryana MSME policy mein... 25% tak capital subsidy! Stamp duty pe 75% subsidy, aur SGST pe 60% tak subsidy! Apna gate. Apna board. Apna address. Forteasia Industrial Township, रोहतक. Zyada jaanne ke liye, is WhatsApp button pe click kijiye!
